item.description: Gas prices in Vermont have dropped below four dollars per gallon, averaging three dollars and ninety-two cents. Burlington prices fell nearly twenty cents to three dollars and ninety cents per gallon. The national average is at its lowest since mid-March, just before Thanksgiving.

Vermont will get over four million dollars in federal funding for housing remediation and weatherization. Four million supports the Healthy Homes program to fix hazards like mold. Three hundred fifty thousand dollars will improve energy efficiency and reduce costs.

Vermont has launched a new online unemployment insurance system called e-Services. It lets claimants file and manage claims anytime online. The system includes privacy protections and accessibility features, said Commissioner Kendal Smith.

The Alburgh Springs border crossing will close December eleventh for a year of renovations. The project will upgrade systems and add a bulletproof inspection booth. Travelers must use nearby crossings in Alburgh or Highgate Springs during the closure.
